semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset on posedge areset; reset dominates clock and selects LEFT. While areset is high, each posedge clk also selects LEFT.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state promised before reset.
semantics.sampling: Bumps sampled at posedge clk when reset is low. Outputs decode registered state (Moore); bump changes between clocks do not change outputs.
semantics.reset_release: Deasserting reset alone does not change state.

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, overflow, saturation, or signed operations.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit transition table derived from problem; compare both outputs after clock and asynchronous reset events.
coverage: All four bump combinations from both states
Bump changes between clocks preserve Moore outputs
Asynchronous reset while walking right between clock edges
Reset held across clock edges with bumps asserted
Reset release preserves LEFT until next clock
verification.tools: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts; testbench watchdog.
